newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May ethylene output little changed yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan May ethylene output little changed yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's ethylene production in May totalled 622,000 tonnes, little changed from 619,000 tonnes for the same month a year earlier, a Trade Ministry official said on Monday.
"The figures mean domestic demand as well as exports remain brisk for petrochemical products," the official said.
Japan's annual ethylene production exceeded seven million tonnes for the first time in 1996 amid healthy domestic demand and strong exports to other Asian countries.
Ethylene is used as the building block for a wide range of petrochemical products.
